goal: The Level 2 book cover for Storytime unit 1: the six sprouts Pat, May, Sam, Mia, Ben, and Nan (drawn young, about five years old) stand close together in a bright kindergarten classroom, wave hello, and smile; Pip the puppy sits in front of them. The top 30 percent of the picture is one calm, plain cream wall with no object and no character, for the title that Workbooks adds later. Pip: a small puppy with golden-brown fur, a cream chest, a cream muzzle, a cream stripe on his forehead, floppy ears with darker tips, large dark-brown eyes, a black nose, a fluffy tail, and a red collar with a small round gold tag. Nan: a five-year-old girl with large dark-brown eyes, short black hair in two small bunches, an orange T-shirt with a white star, red shorts, and white sneakers. No letters, words, or numbers anywhere.
colorPrompt: Make an edited version of picture 1. Picture 1 is a finished children's book cover picture. Keep picture 1 exactly: the same room, the same six children in the same places and poses, the same Pip, the same camera, the same plain cream wall in the top 30 percent, and the same soft, round, bright 3D render look. Pictures 2 to 6 are only look references of the same room, the same children, and the same puppy: Picture 2 is the empty classroom, picture 3 shows Pat, May, Sam, and Mia, picture 4 shows Ben, picture 5 shows Nan, and picture 6 shows the puppy Pip. Change only the six waving hands. Each waving hand shows ONE thumb and FOUR fingers, five digits in all: the four fingers are spread apart, the thumb points out to the side, and each digit is clearly seen and has a rounded tip. Never draw three fingers. Never draw a mitten or a fist. The other hand of each child stays down at the side as in picture 1. Each child stands firmly on the floor with a soft contact shadow under the feet. The top 30 percent of the picture stays one plain, smooth, even cream wall color with no object, no shadow, no pattern, no character, and no head, hand, or hair of any child. Exactly six children, one puppy, and no other person or animal. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing anywhere. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
